exposure: Laparoscopically assisted excision of umbilical endometriosis via a 'Darwish point' entry portal
outcome: Complete resolution of the umbilical endometriosis mass
cohort: The study describes a patient with umbilical endometriosis managed with a novel surgical technique and postoperative hormonal therapy.
finding: The described modified technique using the 'Darwish point' for abdominal access and aesthetic umbilicus repair, combined with postoperative Dienogest therapy, achieved complete resolution of umbilical endometriosis and aesthetic preservation of the umbilicus.
followup_time: At least 3 months (duration of Dienogest therapy)
